column1: # The Attachments window's second sight: the optics each weapon takes on its offset rail, one row a
# (weapon dict id, optic dict id); sides the rail's sides it goes on, a mask (1 left, 2 right:
# survarium.upgrade.SightPlace). A weapon with no row has no second-sight slot. The lobby build
# makes it the class survarium.data.SecondSights (tools/actionscript/README.md, "Tables"); its
# list fits must have a row (the movie reads SecondSights.fits). To be written from the content
# pack's modules table; these rows are the harness's until then: the HK416 (2218) with the
# Leupold DeltaPoint (2112) and the Hensoldt RSA-S (2116).
